spec.name: Quiet names v13
spec.notes: Long the calm names, short the jumpy ones.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 6%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation. While the reported Sharpe ratio and drawdown appear reasonable, the lack of a proper test set and the inclusion of transaction costs in the backtest raise concerns. The research log indicates only a limited number of trials and that this is not the best performing strategy. Paper trading is recommended to further evaluate its robustness.
